headline: CHW @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHW 3.23 at DET 5.28, with a projected total of 8.51. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward DET: CHW moved -0.51 runs while DET moved +1.16, changing the projected margin by -1.67 runs. The projected total climbed +0.72, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Tarik Skubal has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Chase Meidroth, Kevin McGonigle, Dillon Dingler, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jacob Gonzalez, James Outman because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
